_comment: Accepted npm audit advisories (GHSA ids) for `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high`. Each needs a reason and a tracking issue. Remove the entry when fixed.

accepted.reason: Stack exhaustion when merging recursive objects. Reached only through the Prisma CLI reading our own prisma config at build/migrate time, never with untrusted input at runtime. The fix needs Prisma 7, a major upgrade ignored per ADR 0008.
